verdict.rationale: Bench documents real-time, downloadable income statements (P&L) and balance sheets that can be shared with banks or investors, with views by real-time, monthly, quarterly, or yearly periods. The evidence never mentions a cash-flow statement, and period selection appears limited to those presets rather than any arbitrary range. Missing for 10: cash-flow statement, arbitrary custom date ranges, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.
